title: Tumors on CT and MRI: lung cancer, hepatocellular carcinoma, vestibular schwannoma
description: Located tumors from three open TCIA collections (CC BY 4.0): four chest CTs of biopsy-proven lung cancer, one per histology (adenocarcinoma, squamous cell, small cell, large cell), with the tumor boxed by thoracic radiologists (Lung-PET-CT-Dx); two baseline liver CTs of hepatocellular carcinoma with the tumor, liver, portal vein and aorta segmented and clinically curated (HCC-TACE-Seg); and one vestibular schwannoma on contrast T1 and high-resolution T2 MRI with the manual Gamma Knife tumor contour (Vestibular-Schwannoma-SEG). Seven different patients.

referenceTargets.unassessedNote: Only the segments in this DICOM SEG are referenced (Liver, Hepatocellular carcinoma, Portal vein, Abdominal aorta); all other anatomy and findings are unassessed.
referenceTargets.teachingNote: HCC-TACE-Seg: baseline CT of a patient with confirmed hepatocellular carcinoma before transarterial chemoembolization (TACE). Per the collection description, the liver, tumor and vessels were segmented semi-automatically in Amira and manually clinically curated; the SEG records SegmentAlgorithmType SEMIAUTOMATIC. The 'Mass' segment is the tumor. The SEG's 'Portal vein' segment (description 'vessels') is not included: on this phase it outlines scattered intrahepatic branches that could not be confirmed as portal venous.
